title: Children you sponsor
intro: You see a child’s pen name, age and progress updates. Further details appear only with the guardian’s consent. Messages go to the madrasa, not to the child.
empty: You are not matched with a child yet. The principal matches one sponsor to one child.
noUpdates: No updates yet. They will appear here when the madrasa publishes them.
photoHeld: A photograph, if one is held, stays with the madrasa and is not shown on this page.
limited: You see the pen name, age and updates. More details appear only after the guardian’s consent, with two sign-offs.
placeholder: Write to the madrasa about this child.
sent: Your message has been sent to the madrasa.
contactBlocked: This message seems to contain a phone number or email. Please remove it to send.
sendUnavailable: This message could not be sent. Sponsorship messages are open only while the match is active.
